scubaInitial: Use case: product-mockup. Create NEW original raster fashion-flat line art for a modular apparel design tool. Draw ONLY one upright SCUBA HOOD, isolated, symmetrical front view, as a sewn garment component with NO torso, shoulders, person, mannequin or labels. White background and blank white fabric interiors, pure black crisp construction lines only; no grey, shadows, colour, fabric texture, logos, drawstrings, zips, hatching or sketch marks. A realistically wearable compact hood: broad softly rounded crown, smooth structured side panels, and a HIGH INTEGRATED CHIN GUARD. The face aperture is a compact rounded oval, WIDER than it is tall, ending at the chin guard ABOVE the base of the hood. The front lower third is a continuous blank fabric panel with a gently curved horizontal upper edge, NOT a V-neck, NOT crossover edges. Outer shape approximately as wide as tall, not tall or narrow, not a balaclava or astronaut helmet. Subtle centre-back construction seam visible ONLY within the inside of the face opening. Simple double line edging around face aperture. Bottom attachment edge is ONE continuous shallow downward-bowed curve from the left base to the right base, closed silhouette. Hood stands naturally upright, not flattened or collapsed. Draw it centred on a square white canvas with generous white margins. Black outline thickness 3px and interior seams 2px at 1024 resolution. Output a raster PNG, not SVG.
scubaRevision: Edit this newly generated raster hood concept into a natural wearable sweatshirt SCUBA HOOD fashion flat. Change the proportions substantially: make the FACE OPENING a large upright rounded rectangle, almost square with smoothly rounded upper corners, occupying about 65% of overall hood height and 65% of width. Move its top edge up to leave only a narrow crown band, about 12% of hood height. End the opening above a SHORT integrated raised chin panel, about 20% of overall height. Remove the paired curved panel seams on the sides and the outer crown centre seam; keep only one fine centre-back seam INSIDE the face opening. The outer hood is compact and softly rounded, almost as wide as tall, tapering slightly inward at the neck. Keep one single curved bottom attachment seam. This is a soft clothing hood held upright for a technical garment drawing, with a raised neckline, NOT protective headgear. White interior and background, crisp pure black lines only, no grey/shading, no torso, text, person, zips, drawstrings or labels. 3px outer and 2px inner lines. Output raster PNG.
funnel: Use case: product-mockup. Create NEW original raster fashion-flat line art for a modular apparel design tool. Draw ONLY one compact FUNNEL-NECK / HOOD HYBRID component, isolated, symmetrical front view, NO torso, shoulders, mannequin, person, text or labels. Pure white background and blank white fabric interiors, clean pure black construction lines only. No shading, grey, texture, colour, logos, drawstrings, zips, hatching or sketch marks. Natural wearable adult apparel, NOT a helmet, NOT a balaclava. A moderately sized softly rounded hood rises behind a DISTINCT SHORT STANDING FUNNEL COLLAR. The funnel wraps around the lower neck as a slightly flared open cylinder: shallow curved upper rim, visible slim inner back rim, broad plain continuous front panel, and a curved lower attachment seam. The raised funnel is about the LOWER THIRD of the whole component and covers the low front hood opening. The hood above it has softly rounded crown and a compact rounded face opening; its side edges terminate naturally BEHIND the funnel collar. The visual distinction must be clear: funnel collar in front, hood at back, with logical seams where they meet. No deep V or overlapping crossover fronts. Overall silhouette approximately as wide as tall, compact and broad, never tall or narrow. Bottom attachment edge is ONE continuous shallow downward-bowed curve joining both collar base corners, closed silhouette, not an oval open bottom. Minimal construction detail, black outline 3px and inner seams 2px at 1024. Centred on square white canvas with generous margins. Output raster PNG, not SVG.
